title: Collect Blue Crashin' Thrashin' Racer Controller

nodes.text: Defeat NPC #52358 at the marked location and loot for Blue Crashin' Thrashin' Racer Controller. Repeat only while eligible; a kill does not prove the toy dropped.

recovery.text: If the enemy is absent, its spawn time is unknown. Check phase or summoning details; choose another activity while waiting.

nodes.text: Use Blue Crashin' Thrashin' Racer Controller from your bags to learn the toy.

recovery.text: If the toy is absent, check bags, bank and mail. Completing an activity or receiving a reward does not establish ownership.
